references.author: OpenAI
references.name: OpenAI Skills Catalog for Codex
references.review_notes: Official public OpenAI GitHub catalog for Codex skills. GitHub API data on 2026-06-16 showed active maintenance and a curated skills directory, but the repository-level license was not declared, so this should be used as a format and ecosystem reference only until per-skill license and provenance are reviewed.
references.runtime_permission_notes: Reference only. Do not auto-install, copy, execute, or promote any OpenAI catalog skill into trusted status without per-skill license review, sanitization, hash recording, and operator approval.

references.author: agentskills
references.name: Agent Skills Specification
references.review_notes: Public Apache-2.0 specification and documentation for Agent Skills. Useful as a compatibility and quality baseline for SKILL.md structure, metadata, progressive disclosure, and skill evaluation, not as a trusted runtime skill source.
references.runtime_permission_notes: Reference only. Use for schema and evaluation alignment. Do not treat the specification site or repository as granting permission to install third-party skill content.

references.author: Snyk
references.name: Snyk Agent Scan
references.review_notes: Public Apache-2.0 security scanner for AI agents, MCP servers, and agent skills. Useful as a supply-chain and prompt-injection threat-model reference for future scanner rules, but external scanner execution must remain a separate operator-approved workflow.
references.runtime_permission_notes: Reference only. Do not execute scanner code or make it a required verifier until install path, inputs, outputs, network behavior, and CI permissions are reviewed.

references.author: multica-ai
references.name: andrej-karpathy-skills CLAUDE.md
references.review_notes: Public GitHub reference for compact AI coding behavior rules. Current GitHub API data on 2026-06-14 showed high public traction, but popularity is not treated as trust and the repository license was not declared. Useful as a market signal and behavioral-rule reference only.
references.runtime_permission_notes: Reference only. Do not copy the file verbatim into trusted skills, install it automatically, execute repository content, or treat star counts as evidence of safety or correctness.

references.author: HKUDS
references.name: AnyTool
references.review_notes: Architecture reference for pre-selecting a compact tool pack before agent execution. Any local adoption must be rewritten as catalog-bound metadata or a reviewed local skill.
references.runtime_permission_notes: Reference only. Do not install, import, execute, or expose its runtime tools through default task packs.

references.author: punkpeye
references.name: Awesome MCP Servers
references.review_notes: Useful as a source-discovery pattern and candidate list. Each downstream MCP server still needs separate provenance, license, risk, and permission review.
references.runtime_permission_notes: Reference only. Directory entries are not trusted skills and must not be auto-installed or auto-executed.

references.author: AskBudi
references.name: AskBudi Roundtable MCP
references.review_notes: Useful as a reference for one-entry MCP ergonomics and auto-discovery patterns. License and exact repository provenance require follow-up review before any conversion.
references.runtime_permission_notes: Reference only. Do not run as a gateway or expose external assistant tools without a separate connector approval path.

references.author: mvanhorn
references.name: last30days-skill
references.review_notes: Real, public, MIT GitHub project with high community traction. Useful pattern for last-30-days social signal briefs, but runtime connectors, browser sessions, paid APIs, and live factual claims require separate operator approval and verification.
references.runtime_permission_notes: Reference only. Do not auto-install, execute, scrape, or expose external accounts/API keys through default task packs. Local adoption is represented by review-required safe workflow metadata only.

references.author: google-antigravity
references.name: Antigravity CLI provenance watch
references.review_notes: The user-supplied google/antigravity-cli path was not found. GitHub search found google-antigravity/antigravity-cli; keep only as a provenance-watch runtime reference until official ownership, license, and permission model are verified.
references.runtime_permission_notes: Reference only. Do not install or run installer commands from README. The repository path is not google/antigravity-cli, so official provenance remains pending unless confirmed by official documentation.
